# Code of conduct

This project follows the spirit of the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful of differing experience levels, languages, and opinions.
- Give feedback about the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming a motive.
- Keep discussion focused on the project.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory or sexualized language or imagery.
- Publishing someone's private information without permission.
- Sustained disruption of issues, discussions, or pull requests.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other space where someone is
representing the project.

## Enforcement

Report problems to the maintainer through GitHub (@jseook11) or with a private report at
<https://github.com/jseook11/Umak/security/advisories/new>. Reports are reviewed
confidentially. The maintainer may warn, edit or remove content, or block an account,
depending on severity and repetition.

## Attribution

This policy is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
